description:
Write, with each archive execution, a record holding that target's executions, so evidence is addressable by target without the event log.

## Background

`finalize_archive_execution` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/archive.rs`) merges its own writes with the issue and event actions into one delta, so one more write joins the same redo record. Executions are `domain::artifact_execution::ArchiveExecution` values, and the event `ArtifactArchiveExecuted` wraps one. Targets are `PlanTarget::Container` and `PlanTarget::Document` (`domain/artifact_plan.rs`). Execute captures its base through `capture_archive_base` (`commands/validate.rs`). A new data-root directory must join `VirtualPath::RECORDS`, from which `RepositoryLayout::tracker_written_paths` (`repository_state/path.rs`) is built; tests in `path.rs` and a helper in `gate_execution.rs` pin that set. Whole-repository validation's fidelity pass (`validation/record_fidelity.rs`) is the guard that stored records reproduce.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each archive execution writes `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, holding the target and its ordered `ArchiveExecution` list (the captured prior list plus this execution), in the same redo record as its event. The key is `container/<issue-id>` or `document/<sha256 of the normalized path>`, built by one `VirtualPath` constructor; the record type derives `JsonSchema`; the directory is a tracker-written path; and execute's capture includes the target's record.
- [hard] REQ-02: Finalizer unit tests show the first execution creating the record and a re-execution appending to it.
- [hard] REQ-03: `record_drift` reports an evidence record that does not reproduce.
title: Archive executions write a per-target evidence record
